title: Al-Insan 76:22-26 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 44 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Insan 76:22-26 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 44. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا (٢٢) إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا (٢٣) فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا (٢٤) وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا (٢٥) وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا (٢٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Qalqalah on ج and on د

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Insan 76:22-26 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 76:22-26 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 76:22-26 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: What times of day are named in 76:25 to 26?
Start reading at «ٱسْمَ» (76:25). How do you pronounce the first letter?
questions.a: Isma: the hamzat al-wasl takes a kasrah.

questions.q: What does 76:24 tell the Prophet ﷺ to do?
options: Be patient with the decision of his Lord and not obey sinners
questions.a: A) Be patient with the decision of his Lord and not obey sinners. 76:24.

questions.q: Al-Insan 76:24: «فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Allah tells the Prophet ﷺ to be patient, remember Allah morning and evening and prostrate at night (76:24 to 26). Which of these could you strengthen this week?
questions.a: For example: morning and evening adhkar, or two rak'ahs at night before sleeping.
